correctness.rationale: For each three-space U in M_3(F_2), L_U(X)=s_4(A,B,C,X) is basis-independent because s_4 is alternating in its first three slots and every GL_3(F_2) basis change has determinant one. The identity and U lie in its kernel; the alternating trace form forces even rank, so only 0, 2, 4 are possible. Independently compiled C++ enumeration of EVERY unique RREF three-space in F_2^9, with s_4 evaluated by all 24 word permutations and exact GF(2) elimination, reproduced exactly 788035 spaces with rank histogram (0:11635,2:122320,4:654080) and 10795 rank-zero spaces containing I_3; hence 840 zero spaces avoid I_3. This is a complete finite census, not an infinite-field theorem.
residual_risks: The trace-rank argument requires standard cyclic-trace identities; no statement is made for other fields, orders or matrix dimensions.
